document:0:685:0.text:
(Neat and elegant handwriting)
Once upon a time, at the heart of Savannah stood a statue of a prince.
The prince was gilded from head to toe, his eyes and sword hilt set with gems as blue and sparkling as the sea. Everyone in the city admired his noble, majestic figure.
Through his sapphire eyes, the statue witnessed the many sorrows and hardships of the mortal world. Sorrow filled his heart, and glistening tears streamed from his beautiful eyes.
One day, a swallow flew in from the south and caught one of the prince's tears in its beak. Like the people of the city, the swallow found itself utterly charmed by him.
"Please take the gems and gold from my body to those who need them. With a heart of lead and a body of stone, I have no use for such treasures," the prince pleaded with the swallow.
The swallow heeded the prince's wish. It carried the gems and gold to the slums, bringing warmth and hope to those living in poverty. Meanwhile, the prince slowly lost his luster.
With winter fast approaching, snow would soon blanket the entire city.
"I'm afraid I'll soon freeze to death," the swallow said in a frail voice, curling up at the prince's feet. "Still, I'd rather die than leave your side."
The prince looked at the shivering swallow, and for the first time, his heart of lead was seized by fear. Although he dreaded spending the long winter alone, it would break his heart to see the swallow die at his feet.
"No, you have to go," the prince told the swallow, his voice not as gentle as before. "I don't need your company anymore. Your presence only reminds me how ugly and useless I've become!"
"But..."
"Leave! Return to the warmth of the south!" the prince ordered sternly. "And don't ever come back!"
The swallow beat its wings in despair. It gave the statue, now only a shadow of its former glory, one last look. Then, with a mournful cry, it soared into the sky and never returned.
Finally, winter came.
Snow settled upon the prince's bare head. His gems were gone, his beautiful appearance had crumbled, and he had lost his only companion.
He still towered over the city, smiling down at it. Yet that smile was frozen forever.
He was reduced to nothing more than a statue with a heart of lead.
document:0:685:0.source_cn:
（娟秀工整的字迹）
很久很久以前，在赛凡纳城市的正中央，矗立着一位王子的雕像。
雕像王子身披金箔，眼眸和剑柄上装点着比海都要蓝的、闪闪发亮的宝石，他是那么神气，那么漂亮，城市里的所有人都爱雕像王子。
雕像王子用蓝宝石的眼睛看见了形形色色的、悲惨又艰辛的人，忧愁侵占了他的心房，他漂亮的眼睛不由得流下了迤逦的、晶莹的泪珠。
一只燕子从遥远的南方飞来，衔起了他的泪珠。和城市里的人们一样，燕子如此轻易地就爱上了雕像王子。
“燕子啊，帮我把宝石和金箔送给那些需要它们的人吧。我只是一座铅心的雕像，要这些又有什么用呢？”雕像王子恳求道。
燕子照做了。它衔着雕像王子身上的宝石和金箔，一次次飞过贫民窟的屋顶，为穷苦的人们带去温暖与希望。而雕像王子自己，却变得越来越黯淡。
冬天很快就要来了。冰冷的霜雪即将覆盖城市的每一个角落。
“王子啊，我很快就要冻死在这里了，”燕子虚弱地靠在雕像王子的脚边，“但我宁愿冻死，也要陪着你。”
雕像王子看着瑟瑟发抖的燕子，那颗铅做的心突然感到了恐惧。他害怕自己将要独自面对漫长的冬天，更害怕看到燕子死在自己脚下。
“不，燕子，你必须走，”雕像王子的声音不再像以前那样温柔了，“我不需要你的陪伴。你留在这里，只会提醒我已经失去了所有的金箔和宝石，提醒我已经变得多么丑陋和无用！”
“可是，王子……”
“走吧！飞到你温暖的南方去！”雕像王子严厉地命令道，“不要再回来了！”
燕子伤心欲绝地拍打着翅膀。它最后看了一眼那个曾经光芒万丈、如今却灰暗斑驳的雕像，发出了一声悲鸣，转身飞向了天空，再也没有回来。
冬天终于降临了。
雪花落满了雕像王子光秃秃的头顶。他失去了所有的宝石，失去了美丽的伪装，也失去了唯一愿意陪伴他的好友。
他依然高高矗立着，微笑俯瞰着这座城市。只是那笑容，再也不会变化了。
他变成了一座真正的、只有铅心的雕像。

I asked Mother why the bird left and never came back, but she didn't answer.
After telling me the story, Mother headed off on another trip. I stayed back by myself, reading and writing.
Mother says I'm very smart. Not every child can write as well as I can.
Mother seems to enjoy being outside more than the palace. She's always looking up at the ▇▇.
It's raining again. Today isn't a very happy day for ▇▇.

She fell from so high above... Her bones were all twisted and broken...
Why? Why does this have to happen?! God of Death, what have we done to deserve this? Why did you take her away from me?!
▇▇ above, please help her... She's in so much pain...
...
...
<style="highlight">She</style>'s gone. Besides me, she was the only person in the world who knew about ▇▇▇▇.
No one will ever read me bedtime stories or hold me tight on rainy days again.
I'm on my own now. I must keep that evil <style="highlight">curse</style> a secret, as she told me to. No one can ever find out about it, not even ▇▇.
For now, I have to keep my head down. Just wait till I grow older, I'll uncover who cast the ▇▇. When that day comes...
I'll finally be free.

仁慈的▇▇在上，救救她吧，她好痛，好痛……

<style="highlight">她</style>不在了。世界上除了我之外，唯一知道▇▇▇▇的人，不在了。
